notes.title: V1.0.1.0 – Improved Controller Support
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

You might have noticed that there was an update to EARTH'S DAWN recently – this has added some additional controller support to the game which gives you a few more options when playing. Specifically, the following controllers are now also supported:

• Direct Input compatible controllers
• DualShock®4 controllers

You can switch your controller type via SYSTEM > Controls > Gamepad. The following improvements/adjustments have also been made:

• Gamepad (XInput)
XInput compatible controllers now have vibration support.

• Keyboard
Buttons are now shown as keys correctly. Also, regardless of the selected input method (so, if the controls are set to Gamepad), use of a keyboard is always possible.

• Gamepad (For D-Input controllers when START is button 12)
If the controller assigned START button is 12, the BACK button will be 11.

• Gamepad (For D-Input controllers when START is button 10)
If the controller assigned START button is 10, the BACK button will be 9.

Please ensure you update your local content to get the most from these new settings. Thanks for your support of the game and we hope you continue to enjoy it!

Mart (RSG Team)
